title: Keratinocyte-Associated Biomarkers Reveal Pathogenic Mechanisms in Acne.
authors: Cai, Sini; Lin, Yinjing; Xie, Heng; Ao, Xian; Liu, Qiwei; Huang, Lining
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过单细胞测序和机器学习识别痤疮角质细胞生物标志物，虽涉及转录因子调控网络但非蛋白质-DNA互作建模核心，方法为纯序列统计与表达分析，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The cellular and molecular complexity of acne pathogenesis has hindered progress toward effective targeted therapies. While keratinocytes are known to influence skin inflammation, their precise transcriptional programs and regulatory circuitry in acne remain unclear. We developed an integrative computational framework that combines single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), gene co-expression network analysis (WGCNA), and two complementary machine learning algorithms (SVM-RFE, LASSO) to identify disease-relevant biomarkers. We mapped acne lesion cellular composition, reconstructed keratinocyte differentiation trajectories, and integrated miRNA-transcription factor-drug interaction networks to link molecular signatures to potential interventions. We uncovered marked keratinocyte heterogeneity and enriched late-stage pro-inflammatory states in acne lesions, accompanied by increased macrophage/monocyte and T cell infiltration. Six keratinocyte-associated biomarkers (PYGL, C10orf99, C12orf75, S100A2, PI3, CARD18) were identified, achieving high diagnostic accuracy (AUC > 0.85). Functional enrichment connected these genes to cytokine and chemokine signaling, while regulatory analysis revealed upstream modulators (hsa-let-7b-5p, FOXC1). Drug-gene network mapping suggested repurposing potential for cyclosporin A and valproic acid. In conclusion, our study delineates a keratinocyte-centered molecular signature that shapes acne pathogenesis and provides potential therapeutic biomarkers.
abstract_zh: 痤疮发病机制的细胞和分子复杂性阻碍了有效靶向治疗的进展。尽管已知角质形成细胞影响皮肤炎症，但其在痤疮中的精确转录程序及调控网络仍不清楚。我们开发了一个整合性计算框架，结合单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）、基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）及两种互补的机器学习算法（SVM-RFE、LASSO）来识别疾病相关生物标志物。我们绘制了痤疮病变的细胞组成图谱，重建了角质形成细胞分化轨迹，并整合了miRNA-转录因子-药物相互作用网络，以将分子特征与潜在干预措施联系起来。我们发现了痤疮病变中显著的角质形成细胞异质性及富集的晚期促炎状态，同时伴有巨噬细胞/单核细胞和T细胞浸润增加。鉴定了六种角质形成细胞相关生物标志物（PYGL、C10orf99、C12orf75、S100A2、PI3、CARD18），其诊断准确性高（AUC > 0.85）。功能富集将这些基因与细胞因子和趋化因子信号传导相关联，而调控分析揭示了上游调节因子（hsa-let-7b-5p、FOXC1）。药物-基因网络映射提示环孢素A和丙戊酸具有药物再利用潜力。总之，我们的研究描绘了以角质形成细胞为中心的分子特征，该特征塑造了痤疮发病机制，并提供了潜在的治疗性生物标志物。
